Theme

fellate verb

also suck off, give oral sex, oral sex, fellatio, blow job

classical

Mart. 2.50.1 (Lewis & Short)
Varr. ap. Non. 113.14: lac hūmānum (the plain sense) (Lewis & Short)

fellō, fellāre, fellāvī

verb, first conjugation

suck; in the obscene sense, suck the penis

(vōx obscēna: Mart.)

Properly to suck milk; Lewis & Short marks the other sense only as “obsc.”.

Other words

  • irrumō, irrumāre, irrumāvī, irrumātum — put the penis in someone’s mouth, make someone suck it; hence abuse, treat with contempt

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Catull. 16.1; Mart. 4.50.2 (Lewis & Short); Catull. 28.9 (to treat in a foul or shameful manner) (Lewis & Short)

    (vōx obscēna: Catull., Mart.)

    The same act from the other side. Lewis & Short gives the root sense, “to give suck”, and then only in mal. part.; the meaning follows from that and from fellō.

  • fellātor, fellātōris m. — a man who fellates

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Mart. 14.74; 11.30 (Lewis & Short)

    (vōx obscēna: Mart.)

See also screw, suck.
